independence: Separate reading branch from the model gate; same-family agent review, not raw experimental reproduction or a formal independent audit PASS.

selection.rationale: All positive/non-exclude recommendations; excluded samples cover METR safety/AI R&D, Sakana enterprise platform, OpenAI code/agent/security/science cases, and DeepMind science/model announcements. This is purposive sampling, not a population precision or recall estimate.

criteria: Identify the actor that changes the artifact; human engineers improving an AI application does not establish autonomous Harness RSI.
Require execution/evaluation feedback to change a reusable prompt, tool, skill, control program or policy; current task output/state and memory content do not suffice.
Require actual later reuse, not only storage, aspiration, a model upgrade or a future roadmap.
Preserve feedback-driven weight training, task generation and content-memory directions as distinct from Harness evolution.
Do not combine evidence from different customer examples into one supposed loop.
rounds: 130 saved-source and extracted-text hash checks across all 65 entries.
Full source-text reading for all 8 non-exclude items, followed by 11 purposively selected excludes.
Counter-evidence check for actor, object, recurrence, persistence, and date; exact quote validation.
Second separate-agent read of Terminal X agrees borderline/defer; no canonical decisions changed.
critical_findings: Three of four model Harness positives are unsupported: FDE, Grupo Boticário, and misalignment monitoring describe human engineering rather than automatic Harness change.
Terminal X remains borderline: feedback to Memory/instructions is explicit but authorship and executable later reuse of revised instructions are not.
Securing frontier training should move from other_direction/data_task to exclude/security background; autonomous attack discovery is not a data/task evolution loop.
My Fish is a content-memory product; ad-stack feedback trains model weights; Third Moment generates synthetic scenarios. None establishes Harness evolution.
The selected excluded items yielded no positive Harness reversal. This does not prove all remaining excludes are correct.

terminal_x_second_reader.rationale_zh: 原文 Engineers turn each Memory into a repeatable workflow 及 analyst corrects 明示人工环节；不能确认 Agent 自动改写并将新程序投入后续执行。模型判卷一致度/成本/检测率也未隔离反馈演化效果。

reviews.headline_zh: 固定多 Agent 生物数据分析
reviews.rationale_zh: 任务结果是生物机制解释和候选实验，未改进这些 Agent 自身的 Harness。分布式与单 Agent 对照并非演化前后对照。

evidence.quote: Each agent investigated a gene disruption, analyzed cellular responses, searched scientific literature, and proposed explanations for the results.
Their reports were combined into a reasoning atlas linking genes, cellular effects, relevant publications, and possible biological mechanisms.
Could a single agent given the entire dataset do just as well as thousands of agents working in parallel? We tested this while keeping the model and resources fixed.

limits: 科研任务产物非 Agent 自身工件

reviews.title: Amp puts AI agents to work beyond code with OpenAI models

model_gate.why_zh: 营销案例，未涉及RSI或Harness演化

reviews.headline_zh: Agent 产品能力与模型选择
reviews.rationale_zh: 模型升级、多 Agent 启动、设计/写作/编程能力均没有形成可验证的 Harness 持续改写闭环。

evidence.quote: Amp chooses and recommends models based on what works best for its users, and OpenAI models account for the majority of tokens used in Amp.
Users can ask Puck to start an agent to investigate a bug, coordinate several agents, or find a previous conversation about a technical problem.

limits: 多 Agent 编排功能不是编排自修改

reviews.title: How Block is building AI-powered security with OpenAI technology

model_gate.why_zh: 企业安全AI应用案例，无递归自改进闭环；固定编排框架不随反馈持久演化

reviews.headline_zh: 人工指导安全系统与外部代码修复
reviews.rationale_zh: 有历史遥测回放评估和 Agent 验证，但团队调整方案，人类指导并部署代码；未证实 Agent 根据反馈演化自身 Harness。

evidence.quote: The team continually evaluates these systems against internal benchmarks and real-world performance, adjusting its approach when needed, including routing work to human review when that is the responsible path.
You propose a patch, you confirm exploitability, and then you verify that you have fixed it, with a human in the loop guiding it and deploying the code changes.

limits: 被评估的固定 Harness 不等于自进化 Harness

reviews.title: Accelerating the search for antimicrobial peptides with Google Antigravity

model_gate.why_zh: 固定科研Agent平台演示，未描述反馈驱动Harness工件修改或持续自改进

reviews.headline_zh: 人引导的抗菌肽发现工作流
reviews.rationale_zh: 交互式科学分析中人选问题和证据，Agent 完成数据库、结构与文献分析。产物是待湿实验验证的候选肽，没有 Agent 程序更新。

evidence.quote: During an interactive, multi-turn session the researcher steers the scientific strategy, deciding which questions to ask and what evidence to collect, while the agent handles the heavy lifting of cross-database orchestration, structural analysis, and literature synthesis.
The candidate we uncover in this walkthrough represents a biologically plausible lead backed by structural and genomic evidence but it still requires wet lab validation.

limits: 当前任务中的多轮分析不是跨任务程序改进

reviews.title: Gemini 4 Carbon: Our next frontier model

model_gate.why_zh: 模型发布，未描述自改进或 Harness 工件反馈更新，与 RSI 无关。

reviews.rationale_zh: 更新的是模型能力与训练；长时任务持续执行没有证明自改写 Harness，也没有在公告中隔离 RSI 环路。

evidence.quote: Today, we’re announcing the next frontier model: Gemini 4 Carbon, our strongest model with state-of-the-art cybersecurity and long horizon capabilities.
With Carbon, we challenged ourselves to go a step further on alignment, and trained the model to respond to complex or high-pressure tasks in the right way.

limits: 模型发布不是 Harness 演化

reviews.title: An updated Model Spec for more capable and beneficial AI

feedback_driven.quote: This update is another step in our work to refine the Spec through research, experience deploying models, public feedback on the Spec and model behavior, and discussions with users and outside experts

persists_across_tasks.quote: We will keep improving both the Spec and the models as we learn from research, real-world use, and feedback.

model_gate.why_zh: 更新模型行为规范，非 Harness 自改进闭环

reviews.headline_zh: 人修订 Model Spec 并训练模型
reviews.rationale_zh: 原文主体是 OpenAI 写规范和训练模型，无自主 Harness 更新。模型引文仅在空白归一化后匹配，原始文本严格子串校验失败，需记录验证口径。

evidence.quote: OpenAI writes the Spec, sets boundaries, and trains models to respect them; developers direct applications within those boundaries; and users direct the model’s work subject to those constraints.

This update is another step in our
work to refine the Spec
through research, experience deploying models,
public feedback
on the Spec and model behavior, and discussions with users and outside experts.

limits: 原始子串与空白归一化匹配需区分
